title: Airline group – goodwill note (exam 2023 type, figures illustrative)
text: Note 12 – Goodwill (unchanged at 365 M£): 'Goodwill is not amortised. It is tested for impairment annually by comparing the carrying amount of the airline CGU with its recoverable amount, determined as value in use: cash flows from the board-approved five-year plan, extrapolated with a long-term growth rate of 2%, discounted with a pre-tax discount rate.'
Key assumptions: pre-tax discount rate 2022: 11.0% (2021: 9.5%); jet fuel price assumption 2022: $900 per tonne (2021: $650 per tonne).

title: Company BUILD – measurement of a machine (exam 2023, simplified)
text: BUILD, a concrete manufacturer, purchased a machine on 1 January N1 for €300,000, to be used only for its concrete production for 10 years. BUILD uses the cost model and straight-line depreciation. For simplicity, keep the original 10-year useful life in all years and consider only impairment and its reversal.

In N1 and N2 production proceeds as planned. In N3 a new environmental law is passed: from N8 concrete manufacturing will be prohibited in the region. In N4 the government votes a transition measure allowing existing facilities to continue until N11.
